profile.headline: Embedded SWE & Scrum Master @ Lockheed Martin | Alabama A&M University Alumnus🐶
profile.summary: Hello, my name is DeTavein (Tay) Walker, I am an alumni of the illustrious Alabama A&M university. I majored in computer science with a concentration in cybersecurity and graduated Magna Cum Laude. I have done a plethora of competitions for the university, and have done research for the AAMU Rise Foundation. My hobbies include video game development and full-stack development.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Co led the Software Team for the LDRD “Tomographic Based Sensing for Large Area Monitoring” project; designed Python algorithms that estimate human/vehicle positions from tomographic images, improving localization accuracy by ≈ 25 % on simulated data.
Presented findings to senior scientists; authored a conference poster (accepted at IEEE SPS 2025).

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.locationName: Mounds View, Minnesota, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Created an AWS Clean Room Collaboration to experiment with sharing and analyzing data without revealing sensitive information that could be harmful towards customers
•	Completed user stories in the backlog that helped refine the systems that were already place making the teams workflow faster and more convenient
•	Utilized several AWS services, created own branches in Azure to test code through different stages, added code to pipelines to test the quality
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · Azure DevOps Services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a software engineer translating code from Visual Basic to Python. Wrote over 3,000 lines of code for the program and also earned a secret clearance while doing so.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · File Management · Visual Basic · Tkinter

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improved the workflow for the company's operations by coding solutions to problems using VBA.
Kept inventory of all chemicals in the plant and kept track of the chemicals in the tanks using a VBA form.

projects.title: Slither
projects.description: An interactive Python teacher that caters to 6-12 grade students to help introduce them to one of the fastest growing coding languages.

projects.title: AAAS HBCU Making & Innovation Showcase
projects.description: Working within a team of 4 to identify a real-world problem, identify and develop a solution, collaborated with the team to focus on the lack of engagement and knowledge of STEM activities for middle school and high school students, created an interactive coding application using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; project is in the prototype stage, introduced to data science and how to use it to solve the problems at hand.
